protocol.name: T4 DNA Ligation
protocol.purpose: To join DNA fragments using T4 DNA ligase for downstream cloning or assembly.

steps.text: Thaw DNA, ligase, and ligase buffer on ice; mix and briefly spin down.
Assemble the ligation reaction in a microcentrifuge tube with DNA fragments, T4 DNA ligase buffer, T4 DNA ligase, and nuclease-free water to the desired final volume.
Mix gently and briefly collect the contents at the bottom of the tube.
Proceed with the ligation product for the next experimental step or store under appropriate conditions if required.

protocol.troubleshooting:
If ligation is poor, confirm that the DNA ends are compatible and that the ligase buffer is fresh and contains ATP.
If background is high, optimize the DNA amount and incubation conditions.
If no product is obtained, repeat the reaction with [time] and [temperature] adjustments.
